stem: Which sequence best supports a dry-room excursion response?
choices: Verify the reading, identify affected scope, inspect relevant equipment/product conditions, document the excursion, and escalate under procedure
Delete the alarm, change setpoints, then inspect product later
Move all lots before verifying the measurement
Wait until final packaging to record the event
rationale: A controlled response verifies the event, defines scope, protects product, documents evidence, and escalates under the approved process.
